svg.title: Machine braid versus a geodesic braid on the default taper
svg.desc: Computed. Top: cover factor of the simulated braid and of the pair of mirror Clairaut foliations through the braid at z = 250 mm, whose leaf spacing is a Jacobi field. Bottom: the constant take-up speed of the run and the quasi-static take-up schedule that would lay the geodesic pair.
svg.text: geodesic pair: r sin α = ±19.2 mm (the braid's value at z = 250 mm)
geodesic pair: r sin α = ±19.2 mm (the braid's value at z = 250 mm)
